entries.keywords: bodmas order of operations brackets pemdas first
entries.a: BODMAS tells us the order: Brackets, Orders (powers), Division and Multiplication, then Addition and Subtraction. So 2 + 3 × 4 = 2 + 12 = 14, not 20.

entries.keywords: fraction numerator denominator parts what is a fraction
entries.a: A fraction shows parts of a whole. In 3/4, the numerator 3 is the parts we have and the denominator 4 is how many equal parts there are. Half a loaf is 1/2.

entries.keywords: area perimeter rectangle square formula length width
entries.a: Perimeter = distance around a shape. For a rectangle: 2 × (length + width). Area = space inside. Rectangle: length × width. Square: side × side.

entries.keywords: triangle area angles sum 180 degrees base height
entries.a: The angles inside a triangle always add up to 180°. Area of a triangle = ½ × base × height.

entries.keywords: circle circumference area radius diameter pi
entries.a: For a circle: diameter = 2 × radius. Circumference = π × diameter (π ≈ 3.14). Area = π × radius × radius.

entries.keywords: prime number composite factors what is a prime
entries.a: A prime number has exactly two factors: 1 and itself. The first primes are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13. Note that 2 is the only even prime.
Even numbers can be shared into two equal groups (2, 4, 6, 8, 10). Odd numbers always have one left over (1, 3, 5, 7, 9).

entries.keywords: percent percentage per cent how to find calculate
entries.a: Percent means 'out of 100'. To find 25% of 80: divide by 100 and multiply by 25, so 80 ÷ 100 × 25 = 20. (Tip: 50% is half, 25% is a quarter, 10% is ÷10.)

entries.keywords: place value units tens hundreds thousands digits
entries.a: Place value: in 457, the 4 means 4 hundreds, the 5 means 5 tens and the 7 means 7 units. So 457 = 400 + 50 + 7.

entries.keywords: pythagoras theorem right angled triangle hypotenuse
entries.a: Pythagoras' theorem: in a right-angled triangle, a² + b² = c², where c is the longest side (the hypotenuse). Example: sides 3 and 4 give c = 5.
Mean = add all the numbers, divide by how many there are. Median = the middle number when in order. Mode = the number that appears most. Range = biggest minus smallest.
